title: Rama at Mt. Prasavana
introduction: After Sugreeva's enthronement, Rama and Lakshmana arrive at a mountain called Prasavana for their stay during rainy season. This mountain contains rich flora and fauna as extolled by Rama. On seeing the beauty of nature Rama's thoughts wander over Seetha and he sinks down in his anguish. But Lakshmana comes to rescue imbuing hopeful thoughts in retrieving her with the help of Sugreeva.

The readers familiar with critical edition may find only twenty-three verses in that edition, whereas this traditional version contains forty-eight of them. Twenty-five verses that account the names of trees, river-flows, beauty of nature etc., extolling nature are here as an ingredient of epical literature that aim to remind us about the need for a good environment, rather than to worry about global warming, ozone depletion, deforestation etc.
closing: इति वाल्मीकि रामायणे आदि काव्ये किष्किन्ध काण्डे सप्त विंशः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 27th chapter in Kishkindha Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
अभिषिक्ते तु सुग्रीवे प्रविष्टे वानरे गुहाम् |
आजगाम सह भ्रात्रा रामः प्रस्रवणम् गिरिम्
verses.iast:
abhiṣikte tu sugrīve praviṣṭe vānare guhām |
ājagāma saha bhrātrā rāmaḥ prasravaṇam girim
verses.translation: Rama along with his brother Lakshmana reached Mt. Prasavana while the enthroned Sugreeva entered the cave-city Kishkindha.

glosses.meaning: anointed, vanara, Sugreeva, on his part

verses.devanagari:
शार्दूल मृग संघुष्टम् सिंहैः भीम रवैः वृतम् |
नाना गुल्म लता गूढम् बहु पादप संकुलम्
ऋक्ष वानर गोपुच्छैः मार्जारैः च निषेवितम् |
मेघ राशि निभम् शैलम् नित्यम् शुचिकरम् शिवम्
verses.iast:
śārdūla mṛga saṅghuṣṭam siṃhaiḥ bhīma ravaiḥ vṛtam |
nānā gulma latā gūḍham bahu pādapa saṅkulam
ṛkṣa vānara gopucchaiḥ mārjāraiḥ ca niṣevitam |
megha rāśi nibham śailam nityam śucikaram śivam
verses.translation: Mt. Prasavana is pervaded with noisily growling tigers and beasts, mightily roaring lions, compacted with diverse shrubs and creeper-plants, overspread with many a kind of tree, thus it is adored by bears, monkeys, baboons, and even by wildcats, and that mountain which is always sanctifying and tranquil is like a heap of clouds in its shine.
notes: As a mass of clouds always showers water this cloudlike mountain also appears to be always showering unspoilt and sanctifying water by way of its rapids, waterfalls and cascades and other water resorts. Hence, it is water giving earthly cloud.

glosses.meaning: with bears, monkeys, baboons, wildcats, also
clouds, heap of, in shine with
always sanctifying, tranquil, mountain, [with unspoilt, water, resorts]

verses.devanagari:
तस्य शैलस्य शिखरे महतीम् आयताम् गुहाम् |
प्रत्यगृह्णीत वासार्थम् रामः सौमित्रिणा सह
verses.iast:
tasya śailasya śikhare mahatīm āyatām guhām |
pratyagṛhṇīta vāsārtham rāmaḥ saumitriṇā saha
verses.translation: Rama along with Lakshmana has taken up an ample spaced cave as residence on the cliff of that mountain.

verses.devanagari:
कृत्वा च समयम् रामः सुग्रीवेण सह अनघ |
काल युक्तम् महद् वाक्यम् उवाच रघुनन्दन
विनीतम् भ्रातरम् भ्राता लक्ष्मणम् लक्ष्मि वर्धनम् |
verses.iast:
kṛtvā ca samayam rāmaḥ sugrīveṇa saha anagha |
kāla yuktam mahad vākyam uvāca raghunandana
vinītam bhrātaram bhrātā lakśmaṇam lakśmi vardhanam |
verses.translation: Rama, the faultless one and the elder brother of Lakshmana, who is the delight of Raghu's dynasty, and who made an accord with Sugreeva regarding cessation of activity during rainy season, spoke these significant and timely words to his humble brother Lakshmana who is the enhancer of prosperity.

glosses.meaning: with Sugreeva, an accord, having made
humble one, prosperity, enhancer of, with Lakshmana
time, bound - befitting to that time, sinificant, word

verses.devanagari:
इयम् गिरि गुहा रम्या विशाला युक्त मारुता
अस्याम् वस्त्याम सौमित्रे वर्ष रात्रम् अरिंदम |
verses.iast:
iyam giri guhā ramyā viśālā yukta mārutā
asyām vastyāma saumitre varṣa rātram ariṃdama |
verses.translation: "This delightful mountain cave is spacious and breezy, hence, oh, enemy destroyer Soumitri, let us stay in this during rainy nights.

glosses.meaning: with adequate, breeze - pleasantly windy - breezy

verses.devanagari:
गिरि शृंगम् इदम् रम्यम् उत्तमम् पार्थिवात्मज
श्वेताभिः कृष्ण ताम्राभिः शिलाभिः उपशोभितम् |
नाना धातु समाकीर्णम् नदी दर्दुर संयुतम्
विविधैः वृक्ष षण्डैः च चारु चित्र लता युतम् |
नाना विहग संघुष्टम् मयूर वर नादितम्
मालती कुंद गुल्मैः च सिंदुवारैः शिरीषकैः |
कदंब अर्जुन सर्जैः च पुष्पितैः उपशोभितम्
verses.iast:
giri śṛṃgam idam ramyam uttamam pārthivātmaja
śvetābhiḥ kṛṣṇa tāmrābhiḥ śilābhiḥ upaśobhitam |
nānā dhātu samākīrṇam nadī dardura saṃyutam
vividhaiḥ vṛkśa ṣaṇḍaiḥ ca cāru citra latā yutam |
nānā vihaga saṅghuṣṭam mayūra vara nāditam
mālatī kuṃda gulmaiḥ ca siṃduvāraiḥ śirīṣakaiḥ |
kadamba arjuna sarjaiḥ ca puṣpitaiḥ upaśobhitam
verses.translation: "This admirable peak of mountain is embellished with white, black and coppery rock faces, oh, prince, thus this is fully overspread with diverse ores. Bristling with rivers and frogs, and brimmed with clumps of various trees along with beautiful and amazing creeper-plants it is elaborated. It is highly reverberated with diverse birds and filled with the screeches of best peacocks. And bloomed Maalati and Jasmine bushes, also trees like Sindhuvara, Shirrishika, further the trees like Kadamba, Arjuna, and Sarja in bloom, are brightening it and it is delightful.
notes: The botanical names for these trees are provided in chapter 1 of Kishkindha, where some more elaborate description of nature is available. These may please be referred there. These lists of trees may not be taken as just for page filling, but they may be regarded as the esteemed natural resources that cause natural and timely rainfalls, which occurs in the next chapter.

glosses.meaning: white ones, black ones, coppery ones
various, tree, clumps, also - brimming with
beautiful, amazing, creeper-plants, along with - it is elaborated
peacocks, best, filled with screeches of
with bloomed, Kadamba, Arjuna, Sarja, also

verses.devanagari:
इयम् च नलिनि रम्या फुल्ल पंकज मण्डितैः |
न अति दूरे गुहाया नौ भविष्यति नृपात्मज
verses.iast:
iyam ca nalini ramyā phulla paṃkaja maṇḍitaiḥ |
na ati dūre guhāyā nau bhaviṣyati nṛpātmaja
verses.translation: "This pleasant lake of lotuses enwreathed with its blossomy lotuses, oh, prince, is available not far away from our cave.

verses.devanagari:
प्राग् उदक् प्रवणे देशे गुहा साधु भविष्यति |
पश्चात् च एव उन्नता सौम्य निवाते अयम् भविष्यति
verses.iast:
prāg udak pravaṇe deśe guhā sādhu bhaviṣyati |
paścāt ca eva unnatā saumya nivāte ayam bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: "This cave with its north-easterly slope will be homely for us since the inrush of rainwater will be less, oh, gentle one, also thus with its upraised westerly portion this cave will be less of gusts that come from east.

glosses.meaning: that is in - east, north, sloppy, place

verses.devanagari:
गुहा द्वारे च सौमित्रे शिला सम तला शिवा |
कृष्णा च एव आयता चैव भिन्न अंजन चय उपममा
verses.iast:
guhā dvāre ca saumitre śilā sama talā śivā |
kṛṣṇā ca eva āyatā caiva bhinna aṃjana caya upamamā
verses.translation: "The black stone available at the doorway of the cave that looks like a spattered mound of mascara is broad, even-surfaced, and will be pleasant for a repose.

verses.devanagari:
गिरि शृंगम् इदम् तात पश्य च उत्तरतः सुभम् |
भिन्न अंजन चय आकारम् अंभोधरम् इव उदितम्
verses.iast:
giri śṛṃgam idam tāta paśya ca uttarataḥ subham |
bhinna aṃjana caya ākāram ambhodharam iva uditam
verses.translation: "See this mountain peak that looks like a scattered mound of mascara, dear boy, which rose up like a black-cloud on the sky, and it is an auspicious one for it is in northern side.

glosses.meaning: water, carrier - black-cloud, like - cloud turned upside down

glosses.itrans: subham idam giri shR^ingam pashya ca
glosses.iast: subham idam giri śṛngam paśya ca
glosses.devanagari: सुभं इदं गिरि शृन्गं पश्य च
glosses.meaning: auspicious one, this, mountain, peak, see, also.

verses.devanagari:
दक्षिणस्याम् अपि दिश स्थितम् श्वेतम् इव अंबरम् |
कैलास शिखर प्रख्यम् नाना धातु विराजितम्
verses.iast:
dakśiṇasyām api diśa sthitam śvetam iva ambaram |
kailāsa śikhara prakhyam nānā dhātu virājitam
verses.translation: "Even see this mountain available in the southerly direction as if a white cloth is spread on sky, which is vying with Mt. Kailash and abounding with many an ore.

verses.devanagari:
प्राचीन वाहिनीम् चैव नदीम् भृशम् अकर्दमम् |
गुहायाः परतः पश्य त्रिकूटे जह्नवीम् इव
चन्दनैः तिलकैः सालैः तमालैः अतिमुक्तकैः |
पद्मकैः सरलैः चैव अशोकैः चैव शोभितम्
verses.iast:
prācīna vāhinīm caiva nadīm bhṛśam akardamam |
guhāyāḥ parataḥ paśya trikūṭe jahnavīm iva
candanaiḥ tilakaiḥ sālaiḥ tamālaiḥ atimuktakaiḥ |
padmakaiḥ saralaiḥ caiva aśokaiḥ caiva śobhitam
verses.translation: "Also see this river unusually sludge-less, flowing from the wide of the cave and streaming eastward, spruced up with trees like Sandalwood, Tilaka, Saala, Tamaala, Atimukta, Padmaka, Sarala, and even with Ashoka trees, and it looks as if River Ganga is flowing in Trikuta.
notes: They are now in Kishkindha and Trikuta is in Himalayan range. There at Mt. Trikuta or Mt. Meru or Himalayan mountains it is River Jahnavi or Ganga and here at Mt. Prasavana the river is Tungabhadra, which is affectionately remembered as River Ganga.

glosses.meaning: to east, streaming, at river, also thus
with trees like - Sandalwood, tialaka, Saala, Tamaala, Atimukta

verses.devanagari:
वानीरैः तिमिदैः चैव वकुलैः केतकैः अपि |
हिन्तालैः तिनिशैः नीपैः वेतसैः कृतमालकैः
तीरजैः शोभिता भाति नाना रूपैः ततः ततः |
वसन आभरण उपेत प्रमद एव अभ्यलंकृता
verses.iast:
vānīraiḥ timidaiḥ caiva vakulaiḥ ketakaiḥ api |
hintālaiḥ tiniśaiḥ nīpaiḥ vetasaiḥ kṛtamālakaiḥ
tīrajaiḥ śobhitā bhāti nānā rūpaiḥ tataḥ tataḥ |
vasana ābharaṇa upeta pramada eva abhyalaṃkṛtā
verses.translation: "With the trees born on the riverbank and available here and there in various shapes, like Vaaniira, Timida, Vakula, Ketaka, and with Hintaala, Tinisha, Niipa, Vetasa, Kritamaala trees, that river is brightened up, and thus that river appears as a dame finely bedecked with raiment and ornaments.

glosses.meaning: with trees like Vaaniira, Timida, Vakula, Ketaka
Hintaala, Tinisha, Niipa, Vetasa, Kritamaala trees
lady, as if, [river is] appears to be.

verses.devanagari:
शतशः पक्षि सन्घैः च नाना नाद विनादिता |
एकैकम् अनुरक्तैः च चक्रवाकैः अलंकृता
पुलिनैः अति रम्यैः च हंस सारस सेविता |
प्रहसंती इव भाति एषा नारी रत्न विभूषिता
verses.iast:
śataśaḥ pakśi sanghaiḥ ca nānā nāda vināditā |
ekaikam anuraktaiḥ ca cakravākaiḥ alaṃkṛtā
pulinaiḥ ati ramyaiḥ ca haṃsa sārasa sevitā |
prahasaṃtī iva bhāti eṣā nārī ratna vibhūṣitā
verses.translation: "This river is fairly resonated with the calls of diverse birds in hundreds of flights, beautified with ruddy gees that are doting one upon the other, and admired by the swans and cranes upon her highly appealing sand-isles, thus she appears to be a damsel decorated with jewels with a toothy grin.
notes: These accounts come under vipra lambha sṛngāra, dear-departed-romanticism. The ruddy gees are this river-damsel's rubbing breasts under her breast-band. The sandy-mounds are her buttocks, or her pearl-white teeth, sārasa Indian cranes are her eyes. The swans, by their nature they are famous for their majestic floating. With such a floating of swans the majestic cruise of the maiden called river is perceptible. The clucking sounds of the birds are like the tinkles from the tinkling bells of that maiden's anklets. alankāra : utprekhsa say, hyperbolic rhetoric.

glosses.meaning: diverse, calls, verily - fairly, resonated with
well, smiling - with a toothy grin, like, appearing to be.

verses.devanagari:
क्वचित् नीलोत्पलैः च्छन्न भाति रक्तोत्पलैः क्वचित् |
क्वचित् भाति शुक्लैः च दिव्यैः कुमुद कुड्मलैः
verses.iast:
kvacit nīlotpalaiḥ cchanna bhāti raktotpalaiḥ kvacit |
kvacit bhāti śuklaiḥ ca divyaiḥ kumuda kuḍmalaiḥ
verses.translation: "Somewhere overspread with blue water-lilies, elsewhere with red water-lilies she is shining forth, and she is also shimmering with the beautiful buds of white water-lilies, somewhere else.

verses.devanagari:
पारिप्लव शतैः जुष्टा बर्हि क्रौन्च विनादिता |
रमणिया नदी सौम्य मुनि संघ निषेविता
verses.iast:
pāriplava śataiḥ juṣṭā barhi kraunca vināditā |
ramaṇiyā nadī saumya muni saṃgha niṣevitā
verses.translation: "With hundreds of waterfowls cherishing it, screeches of peacocks and cackles of curlews reverberating around, assemblages of sages bustling about, this gracious river is heart-pleasing.

glosses.meaning: by peacocks, by curlews, much, noised - reverberant with screams cackles
by saint, assemblages, served by - bustling around

verses.devanagari:
पश्य चंदन वृक्षाणाम् पंक्ती सुरुचिरा इव |
ककुभानम् च दृश्यन्ते मनसा इव उदिताः समम्
verses.iast:
paśya caṃdana vṛkśāṇām paṃktī surucirā iva |
kakubhānam ca dṛśyante manasā iva uditāḥ samam
verses.translation: "As if seeded by the wish of some divine creativity the rows of sandalwood trees that are virtually captivating have sprang forth uniformly, so also, the rows of Arjuna trees too appear in a similar pattern.

glosses.meaning: [seeded] by the wish of [some divine creativity]
Kakubha - Arjuna trees, [rows of,] also - appear in similar pattern.

verses.devanagari:
अहो सुरमणीयो अयम् देशः शत्रु निषूदन |
दृढम् रंस्याव सौमित्रे साधु अत्र निवसावहे
verses.iast:
aho suramaṇīyo ayam deśaḥ śatru niṣūdana |
dṛḍham raṃsyāva saumitre sādhu atra nivasāvahe
verses.translation: "Aha! Soumitri, very exhilarating is this locale and we can happily reside here, oh, enemy-eliminator, we can certainly take delight in this environ.

glosses.meaning: certainly, we take delight - in this environ.

verses.devanagari:
इतः च न अति दूरे सा किष्किंधा चित्र कानना |
सुग्रीवस्य पुरी रम्या भविष्यति नृपात्मज
verses.iast:
itaḥ ca na ati dūre sā kiṣkiṃdhā citra kānanā |
sugrīvasya purī ramyā bhaviṣyati nṛpātmaja
verses.translation: "Further, oh, prince, hedged in charming groves that exquisite Kishkindha, the city of Sugreeva, will not be very far off from here.

verses.devanagari:
गीत वादित्र निर्घोषः श्रूयते जयताम् वर |
नदताम् वानराणाम् च मृदंग आडंबरैः सह
verses.iast:
gīta vāditra nirghoṣaḥ śrūyate jayatām vara |
nadatām vānarāṇām ca mṛdaṃga āḍambaraiḥ saha
verses.translation: "The melodies of singing and the tunes of musical instruments played and sung in Kishkindha are heard from here, oh, the best-triumphant Lakshmana, and even the blares of vanara-s together with their snobbish drumming is heard, hence it is not far away.

glosses.meaning: oh, among triumphant ones, best one
singing, musical instrument's, out flowing - melodies

verses.devanagari:
लब्ध्वा भार्याम् कपिवरः प्राप्य राज्यम् सुहृत् वृतः |
ध्रुवम् नंदति सुग्रीवः संप्राप्य महतीम् श्रियम्
verses.iast:
labdhvā bhāryām kapivaraḥ prāpya rājyam suhṛt vṛtaḥ |
dhruvam naṃdati sugrīvaḥ samprāpya mahatīm śriyam
verses.translation: "It is definite that the best monkey Sugreeva must be surrounded by his friends, thus he must be exuberant, as he won an utmost prosperity in winning back his wife and winning the kingdom." Rama thus spoke to Lakshmana.

verses.devanagari:
इति उक्त्वा न्यवसत् तत्र राघवः सह लक्ष्मणः |
बहु दृश्य दरी कुंजे तस्मिन् प्रस्रवणे गिरौ
verses.iast:
iti uktvā nyavasat tatra rāghavaḥ saha lakṣmaṇaḥ |
bahu dṛśya darī kuṃje tasmin prasravaṇe girau
verses.translation: Raghava having said thus resided on that Mt. Prasavana along with Lakshmana, whereat many sightly caves and arbours are there.

verses.devanagari:
सुसुखे हि बहु द्रव्ये तस्मिन् हि धरणी धरे |
वसतः तस्य रामस्य रतिः अल्पा अपि न अभवत्
verses.iast:
susukhe hi bahu dravye tasmin hi dharaṇī dhare |
vasataḥ tasya rāmasya ratiḥ alpā api na abhavat
verses.translation: Though that mountain is indeed very comfortable, though it possess many objects of nature like flowers, fruits and waters, indeed, there is no slightest bliss to Rama while he resided there.

glosses.meaning: with many, objects - like flowers, water etc
therein, by earth, borne one - on mountain

verses.devanagari:
हृताम् हि भार्याम् स्मरतः प्राणेभ्यो अपि गरीयसीम् |
उदय अभ्युदितम् दृष्ट्वा शशांकम् च विशेषतः
verses.iast:
hṛtām hi bhāryām smarataḥ prāṇebhyo api garīyasīm |
udaya abhyuditam dṛṣṭvā śaśāṃkam ca viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: He felt despondent in reminiscing about his wife who is loftier that his lives, but who is kidnapped, especially on seeing the moon just risen on the eastern mountain.

glosses.meaning: from eastern mountain, just, risen, moon, on seeing

verses.devanagari:
आविवेश न तम् निद्रा निशासु शयनम् गतम् |
तत् समुत्थेन शोकेन बाष्प उपहत चेतसम्
verses.iast:
āviveśa na tam nidrā niśāsu śayanam gatam |
tat samutthena śokena bāṣpa upahata cetasam
verses.translation: That anguish which is surging high in him has rendered him with a bosom marred with tears, thereby sleep has no effect on him even if he has gone to bed in nights.

glosses.meaning: by tears, marred, with a bosom
in nights, to bed, on going
sleep, has not, taken hold of - ineffective.

verses.devanagari:
तम् शोचमानम् काकुत्स्थम् नित्यम् शोक परायणम् |
तुल्य दुःखो अब्रवीद् भ्राता लक्ष्मणो अनुनयम् वचः
verses.iast:
tam śocamānam kākutstham nityam śoka parāyaṇam |
tulya duḥkho abravīd bhrātā lakṣmaṇo anunayam vacaḥ
verses.translation: While pacifying Rama who is pensive and who is always subjected to grief, his brother Lakshmana who is similarly sad for his brother's sadness spoke these words.

glosses.meaning: always, to grief, who is subjected to
one who is - similarly, sad - for his brother

verses.devanagari:
अलम् वीर व्यथाम् गत्वा न त्वम् शोचितुम् अर्हसि |
शोचतो हि अवसीदन्ति सर्व अर्था विदितम् हि ते
verses.iast:
alam vīra vyathām gatvā na tvam śocitum arhasi |
śocato hi avasīdanti sarva arthā viditam hi te
verses.translation: "Oh, brave one, enough is this anguishing of yours, and it will be inapt of you to dishearten. All objectives will backslide for them who will be ceaselessly anguishing. That you know clearly.

glosses.meaning: to you, known, indeed - you know it clearly.

verses.devanagari:
भवान् क्रिया परो लोके भवान् देव परायणः |
आस्तिको धर्म शीलः च व्यवसायी च राघव
verses.iast:
bhavān kriyā paro loke bhavān deva parāyaṇaḥ |
āstiko dharma śīlaḥ ca vyavasāyī ca rāghava
verses.translation: "Oh, Raghava, in the world you are a result-oriented person, and a devotee of gods for achieving those desired results, you are the theist, moralist, and also the mobilizer.

glosses.meaning: in world, you are, results, oriented
you are, to gods, dedicated to - in achieving proper results of your deeds

verses.devanagari:
न हि अव्यवसितः शत्रुम् राक्षसम् तम् विशेषतः |
समर्थः त्वम् रणे हन्तुम् विक्रमैः जिह्म कारिणम्
verses.iast:
na hi avyavasitaḥ śatrum rākṣasam tam viśeṣataḥ |
samarthaḥ tvam raṇe hantum vikramaiḥ jihma kāriṇam
verses.translation: "If you are much too lackadaisical, indeed, you will not be capable to eliminate the enemy in war, specially a demon, especially a trickster, let alone all of your daring enterprises.

glosses.meaning: if you are - without, endeavouring - lackadaisical

verses.devanagari:
समुन्मूलय शोकम् त्वम् व्यवसायम् स्थिरी कुरु |
ततः सपरिवारम् तम् राक्षसम् हन्तुम् अर्हसि
verses.iast:
samunmūlaya śokam tvam vyavasāyam sthirī kuru |
tataḥ saparivāram tam rākṣasam hantum arhasi
verses.translation: "On completely rooting out that agony then you stabilise your endeavour, and then you will be able to eliminate that demon Ravana along with his followers.

glosses.meaning: then, with, followers, him, that demon - Ravana
to kill, you will be able to.

verses.devanagari:
पृथिवीम् अपि काकुत्स्थ ससागर वन अचलाम् |
परिवर्तयितुम् शक्तः किम् पुनः तम् हि रावणम्
verses.iast:
pṛthivīm api kākutstha sasāgara vana acalām |
parivar.htayitum śaktaḥ kim punaḥ tam hi rāvaṇam
verses.translation: "Oh, Kakutstha, you are capable to inverse the order of earth along with all of its oceans, forests, and mountains, then what to speak of that Ravana, all the more.

glosses.meaning: reverse, motion, to cause - to inverse the order of
him, about Ravana, why, [talk about] again, all the more.

verses.devanagari:
शरत् कालम् प्रतीक्षस्व प्रावृट् कालो अयम् आगतः |
ततः स राष्ट्रम् स गणाम् रावणम् तम् वधिष्यसि
verses.iast:
śarat kālam pratīkśasva prāvṛṭ kālo ayam āgataḥ |
tataḥ sa rāṣṭram sa gaṇām rāvaṇam tam vadhiṣyasi
verses.translation: "Look forward to the autumnal season, as this season that has come is of heavy rains, and thereafter, you will eradicate that Ravana along with his city-state and his followers.

glosses.meaning: this one is, heavy, rainy, season, that has come
autumnal, season, forward, look on - look forward to
with, his city-state, with, his followers

verses.devanagari:
अहम् तु खलु ते वीर्यम् प्रसुप्तम् प्रतिबोधये |
दीप्तैः आहुतिभिः काले भस्म चन्नम् इव अनलम्
verses.iast:
aham tu khalu te vīryam prasuptam pratibodhaye |
dīptaiḥ āhutibhiḥ kāle bhasma cannam iva analam
verses.translation: "I am just awakening the fast sleeping vitality of yours, no more than rekindling fire concealed under embers with the timely offerings of flammable fire-oblations." Thus said Lakshmana to Rama.

glosses.meaning: enkindling, by offering of flammable fire-oblations
by embers, concealed, fire, as with
in turn, edifying - awakening in you, just.

verses.devanagari:
लक्ष्मणस्य हि तद् वाक्यम् प्रतिपूज्य हितम् शुभम् |
राघवः सुहृदम् स्निग्धम् इदम् वचनम् अब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
lakṣmaṇasya hi tad vākyam pratipūjya hitam śubham |
rāghavaḥ suhṛdam snigdham idam vacanam abravīt
verses.translation: Honouring that expedient and propitious advise of Lakshmana, Raghava spoke this sentence to that good-hearted and good-natured Lakshmana.

glosses.meaning: Lakshmana's, expedient, propitious, that, sentence - advise

verses.devanagari:
वाच्यम् यद् अनुरक्तेन स्निग्धेन च हितेन च |
सत्य विक्रम युक्तेन तद् उक्तम् लक्ष्मण त्वया
verses.iast:
vācyam yad anuraktena snig.hdhena ca hitena ca |
satya vikrama yuktena tad uktam lakṣmaṇa tvayā
verses.translation: "What is to be said by an affectionate, amiable and cordial person, also whose courage is truth itself, that you have said it, Lakshmana.

glosses.meaning: by an affectionate one, amiable one, cordial one, also
truth, courage, one who has it
which, word is to be said

verses.devanagari:
एष शोकः परित्यक्तः सर्व कार्य अवसादकः |
विक्रमेषु अप्रतिहतम् तेजः प्रोत्साहयामि अहम्
verses.iast:
eṣa śokaḥ parityaktaḥ sarva kārya avasādakaḥ |
vikrameṣu apratihatam tejaḥ protsāhayāmi aham
verses.translation: "Yes! Distress is retrogressive to all the functions. I am casting-off this distress completely. As an undefeatable one in my triumphs I am invigorating my ebullience.

glosses.meaning: not, back, strikable - not possible for a strike back - undefeatable

verses.devanagari:
शरत् कालम् प्रतीक्षिष्ये स्थितो अस्मि वचने तव |
सुग्रीवस्य नदीनाम् च प्रसादम् अनुपालयन्
verses.iast:
śarat kālam pratīkśiṣye sthito asmi vacane tava |
sugrīvasya nadīnām ca prasādam anupālayan
verses.translation: "Awaiting for the kind-heartedness of Sugreeva, and for the kindness of the rivers in their abatement, I look forward for the autumn remaining true to your words.

glosses.meaning: your, word, staying, I am - I abide by your words.

verses.devanagari:
उपकारेण विरः तु प्रतिकारेण युज्यते |
अकृतज्ञो अप्रतिकृतो हन्ति सत्ववताम् मनः
verses.iast:
upakāreṇa viraḥ tu pratikāreṇa yujyate |
akṛtajño apratikṛto hanti satvavatām manaḥ
verses.translation: "A valiant one who is succoured will be indebted with some requital on his part, but besides being unfaithful, if one who does not make requital for all the favours done in his interest, he will be wounding the hearts of soft-hearted people." Rama said so to Lakshmana, keeping Sugreeva in view.

verses.devanagari:
तत् एव युक्तम् प्रणिधाय लक्ष्मणः
कृत अंजलि तत् प्रतिपूजय भाषितम् |
उवाच रामम् स्वभिराम दर्शनम्
प्रदर्शयन् दर्शनम् आत्मनः शुभम्
verses.iast:
tat eva yuktam praṇidhāya lakśmaṇaḥ
kṛta aṃjali tat pratipūjaya bhāṣitam |
uvāca rāmam svabhirāma darśanam
pradarśayan darśanam ātmanaḥ śubham
verses.translation: Visualising what Rama said about their waiting for pre-winter season to be candid, and praisefully making palm-fold at that determination of Rama, and even to clarify his own opportune viewpoint, Lakshmana spoke to Rama who by his own aspect is a delightful one for a ken.

glosses.meaning: that, alone - what Rama said about their waiting for cessation of rains
that, what is said by Rama, honouring - praisefully
his own, opportune, viewpoint, to clarify
one with his - own, best, delightful, aspect - Rama

verses.devanagari:
यथोक्तम् एतत् तव सर्वम् ईप्सितम्
नरेन्द्र कर्ता न चिरात् तु वानर |
शरत् प्रतीक्षः क्षमताम् इमम् भवान्
जल प्रपातम् रिपु निग्रहे धृतः
verses.iast:
yathoktam etat tava sarvam īpsitam
narendra kartā na cirāt tu vānara |
śarat pratīkśaḥ kśamatām imam bhavān
jala prapātam ripu nigrahe dhṛtaḥ
verses.translation: "Oh, lord of people, Sugreeva will be effectuating everything you have desired and said, not later but soon, hence awaiting autumn you may please bear up these heavy rainfalls, besides bearing with the idea of disciplining the enemy.

glosses.meaning: everything, completely, he will be doing

verses.devanagari:
नियम्य कोपम् प्रतिपाल्यताम् शरत्
क्षमस्व मासाम् चतुरो मया सह |
वस अचले अस्मिन् मृग राज सेविते
संवर्तयन् शत्रु वधे समर्थः
verses.iast:
niyamya kopam pratipālyatām śarat
kṣamasva māsām caturo mayā saha |
vasa acale asmin mṛga rāja sevite
saṃvartayan śatru vadhe samarthaḥ
verses.translation: "Let autumn be awaited while containing your anger, and along with me you may stay on this mountain which is adored by lions, and spend these four rainy months here like a monsoon lion, although you are capable to eliminate the enemy at any moment like a lion.

glosses.meaning: in enemy, elimination, capable as you are [gearing up]
four, months, come to pass - spending time
